# PredictAlpha

> PredictAlpha is an AI-powered Bitcoin price prediction tool. It runs an LSTM + XGBoost + Prophet ensemble across 7 timeframes (1H, 4H, 8H, 12H, 24H, 1 week, 1 month), combining live price, on-chain, derivatives, and sentiment data. Currently covers Bitcoin; Ethereum and Gold are coming soon.

## Key facts
- Directional accuracy: 57–68% depending on horizon (benchmarked live on /proof).
- Models: LSTM neural net, XGBoost, Prophet, combined by an accuracy-weighted meta-learner.
- Pricing: Free (2 predictions/day, 1H only) or PRO at $12.99/month (all timeframes, 20 deep analyses/day).
- Not financial advice; educational/analytical tool.
